subject: [Invite] Encord AI Leaders Dinner @ Kokkari 02/27
text:
Hi [NAME],

Our Co-Founders, [SENDER] & [SENDER], will be hosting an intimate AI roundtable
dinner for customers & AI leaders and we'd love for you to join if you're
available. We've been following you guys for a while so v keen to meet in
person.

We've booked a private dining room at Kokkari in SF on Thursday February
27th 6:30-9:30pm, capping attendance to ~25 people. Attendees include CxOs
from leading VC-backed scale-ups & enterprises such as Archetype AI,
Kaliber Labs, Digital Diagnostics, Reality Defender, Abbott, Intuitive etc.
We will also be joined by a few of our investors, including Next47 and CRV.

Bit of context on Encord...we're a computer vision scale-up (recently
raised a $30M Series B) focused on consolidating data curation, annotation,
workflow management and model evaluation under one platform.

Thought it was a good opportunity to get connected - would you be
interested in joining? I can send over an invite if so.

subject: Encord & [COMPANY] | Chatted to Ken
text:
Hi [NAME],

Hope you're well. We've been chatting to Ken these past few days about
partnering with Encord for your data annotation & curation needs.

He mentioned the team is also looking at Labelbox? A lot of partners moved
to Encord from LB recently over concerns that they're becoming a services
provider rather than focusing on their platform. We're very excited about
this partnership and would be happy to help you weigh the pros & cons - can
tell you what we're good at and not so good at as well to be transparent.

Finally, our co-founder [SENDER] (Cc'ed) is hosting an event at GitHub HQ in
SF later today at 5:30pm for AI product builders to share their experience
in 20 min lightning talks. We'd love for you to join if you're around. More
details here
<[LINK]>
.

subject: We have an MSA with [COMPANY] | AI annotation, curation & evaluation
text:
Hi [NAME]​, 

We have an MSA in place with [COMPANY] as we work with some of the AI & Computer Vision teams there on use cases such as robotics and automated visual inspection. Thought we could take advantage of the existing legal infrastructure to explore how we might collaborate with your specific team within BH as well.

For context, sophisticated AI/ML teams like [COMPANY], Fraunhofer or Philips usually come to us when they're at the point of scaling their model training & data pipelines. They mostly use Encord to improve their data curation / annotation and model evaluation processes to iterate on their AI models faster and/or reduce development costs. 

Could be great to chat and get your feedback on what we've built for some of the other [COMPANY] teams. Open to catch up this week? My Thursday's looking pretty open right now.

subject: Woven - data curation solution
text:

Open to learning more?
